changes: Shared opening preparation remains immediate when the first offer is ready. Preparation status is not consumed as a post-pick quip.
Implements six-pick-overtime-v1: Neutral after 1/5, Reaction then one complete Person group after 2, Reaction after 3, Neutral/Reaction/Person after 4/6. Era decoration no longer replaces a category.
Reaction-first picks 2/3 show activity until the saved acknowledgement provides hunch; an older successful replay without hunch uses early. Neutral-first late hunch changes only the unseen tail.

Copy and category metadata are validated together; once-per-launch refresh cannot replace the updated bundle with an older payload lacking pacing metadata/Overtime. The source-derived generator writes both fallback copy and oracle.
One tap retains pick index/title/queue through vote save and final-writing transitions. Dwell starts once on actual paint; duplicate frame callbacks and delayed timers cannot reset or catch up.

A ready read/report replaces the wait immediately unless a two-line Person setup has actually painted; its punchline then receives a full 2500ms beat. Failures interrupt immediately. Cancelled/stale deliveries cannot repaint another wait.

Only pick-six actual final writing adds twelve ordered Overtime lines, each once, then holds the last line with writing activity. Early-four, earlier exhaustion and skips never enter Overtime; no generic pool recycling.

Only displayed post-pick copy is persisted in owner/interview-scoped history. Unseen groups remain eligible, interrupted setup groups do not produce orphan punchlines, retries reuse only unexposed copy.
Existing server-owned checkpoints 2/4, four/six completion, saved flow, score/evidence/LLM/retry boundaries, account, guest save, sharing and report behavior remain in their established layers.
